title: 🎉 Dashed Underline Loader with CSS Animation 🚀
description:
I’ve built a Dashed Underline Loader using HTML and CSS! This cool project displays a bold "Loading..." text with a dashed underline that slides smoothly from right to left in an infinite loop. It’s a fun, stylish way to indicate loading progress, all without JavaScript! 🌟

  • What’s it about? A text loader with a dashed underline that animates using a repeating gradient and background-position shift.

  • The result? A playful, dynamic loading effect with a modern dashed-line vibe.

  • Main key of the code: The @keyframes animation moves the background-position of a repeating-linear-gradient, with steps() timing for a choppy, dashed look.

  • How can users benefit? Use it as a quirky loading indicator, adjust the dash pattern or speed to your taste, or dive into CSS gradient animations!
shortDescription: ✨ A "Loading..." text with a sliding dashed underline, crafted with CSS. Fun and fresh!
